Package index

Estimation

FGLS estimators and their options.

fgls()
Feasible GLS for serial correlation and/or heteroskedasticity
serial_fgls()
Feasible GLS for serially correlated errors (Perron and González-Coya, 2026)
lasso_fgls()
Feasible GLS under heteroskedasticity of unknown form (González-Coya and Perron, 2024)
fgls_control()
Advanced options for fgls

Working with fits

summary(<fgls>) print(<summary.fgls>)
Summarize an fgls fit
vcov(<fgls>) confint(<fgls>) residuals(<fgls>) fitted(<fgls>) predict(<fgls>) nobs(<fgls>) df.residual(<fgls>) formula(<fgls>) model.matrix(<fgls>) model.frame(<fgls>) terms(<fgls>) print(<fgls>)
Methods for fgls fits
plot(<fgls>)
Diagnostic plots for fgls fits
compare_fgls()
Compare fits side by side
tidy(<fgls>) glance(<fgls>) augment(<fgls>)
Tidy, glance and augment fgls fits

Benchmarks

OLS with HAC/HC standard errors, Cochrane-Orcutt, Durbin, infeasible and hybrid GLS.

ols_robust() cochrane_orcutt() durbin_estimator() infeasible_gls() hybrid_gls()
Benchmark estimators

Diagnostics

test_predetermined() print(<fgls_predetermined>)
Test whether lags of the regressors are missing (pre-determinedness)
adf_test() print(<fgls_adf>)
Augmented Dickey-Fuller test (screening)
weight_diagnostics() ar_roots() nonexogeneity_share()
Diagnostics of an fgls fit

make_dictionary()
Candidate covariates for the skedastic function
